source.text: וְדָוִ֥יד זָקֵ֖ן וְשָׂבַ֣ע יָמִ֑ים וַיַּמְלֵ֛ךְ אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And David [was] old and full of days, and he made king Solomon his son over Israel.

en.L: And David was old and full of days, and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
en.B: When David was old and had lived a full life, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.
en.R: David was now old and had lived a long, full life. He made his son Solomon king over Israel.

es.L: Y David era viejo y lleno de días, e hizo a Salomón su hijo rey sobre Israel.
es.B: Cuando David era ya viejo y había vivido una vida plena, hizo a su hijo Salomón rey sobre Israel.
es.R: David ya era viejo y había vivido una vida larga y plena. Hizo a su hijo Salomón rey de Israel.

fr.L: Et David était vieux et rassasié de jours, et il fit Salomon son fils roi sur Israël.
fr.B: Quand David fut vieux et eut vécu une vie bien remplie, il fit de son fils Salomon le roi d’Israël.
fr.R: David était maintenant vieux, et il avait vécu une longue vie bien remplie. Il a fait de son fils Salomon le roi d’Israël.

sw.L: Daudi alikuwa mzee na ameshiba siku, naye akamfanya Sulemani mwanawe kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli.
sw.B: Daudi alipokuwa mzee na ameishi maisha kamili, alimfanya mwanawe Sulemani kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli.
sw.R: Sasa Daudi alikuwa mzee, naye alikuwa ameishi maisha marefu na kamili. Akamfanya mwanawe Sulemani kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli.

vi.L: Đa-vít đã già và trọn đủ ngày, ông lập Sa-lô-môn con trai mình làm vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Khi Đa-vít đã già và hưởng trọn tuổi đời, ông lập Sa-lô-môn con trai mình làm vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Đa-vít đã già và đã sống một đời lâu dài, trọn vẹn. Ông lập Sa-lô-môn con trai mình làm vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 늙어 날이 찼을 때, 자기 아들 솔로몬을 이스라엘의 왕으로 세웠다.
ko.B: 다윗은 나이가 많아 늙자, 자기 아들 솔로몬을 이스라엘의 왕으로 세웠다.
ko.R: 다윗은 이제 늙었고 오래 살았다. 그는 자기 아들 솔로몬을 이스라엘의 왕으로 세웠다.

pt.L: E Davi [estava] velho e farto de dias, e fez Salomão, o seu filho, rei sobre Israel.
pt.B: Quando Davi ficou velho, depois de viver uma vida plena, fez o seu filho Salomão rei sobre Israel.
pt.R: Davi já estava velho e tinha vivido uma vida longa e completa. Ele fez o seu filho Salomão rei de Israel.

am.L: ዳዊትም ሸመገለ፤ ዘመንንም ጠገበ፤ ልጁንም ሰሎሞንን በእስራኤል ላይ አነገሠው።
am.B: ዳዊት ሸምግሎ ዕድሜ በጠገበ ጊዜ ልጁን ሰሎሞንን በእስራኤል ላይ አነገሠው።
am.R: ዳዊት አሁን አርጅቶ ነበር፤ ረጅምና የተሟላ ሕይወትም ኖሯል። ልጁን ሰሎሞንን በእስራኤል ላይ አነገሠው።

hi.L: और दाऊद बूढ़ा और दिनों से तृप्त था, और उसने अपने पुत्र सुलैमान को इस्राएल पर राजा बनाया।
hi.B: जब दाऊद बूढ़ा हो गया और भरपूर आयु पा चुका, तब उसने अपने पुत्र सुलैमान को इस्राएल पर राजा बनाया।
hi.R: दाऊद अब बूढ़ा हो गया था, और उसने लंबा, भरा-पूरा जीवन जिया था। उसने अपने बेटे सुलैमान को इस्राएल पर राजा बनाया।

ru.L: И Давид состарился и насытился днями, и поставил Соломона, своего сына, царём над Израилем.
ru.B: Когда Давид состарился и прожил полную жизнь, он сделал своего сына Соломона царём над Израилем.
ru.R: Давид был уже стар и прожил долгую, полную жизнь. Он сделал своего сына Соломона царём над Израилем.

uk.L: І Давид був старий і ситий днями, і він настановив царем над Ізраїлем Соломона, свого сина.
uk.B: Коли Давид постарів і прожив повне життя, він настановив свого сина Соломона царем над Ізраїлем.
uk.R: Давид був уже старий і прожив довге, повне життя. Він настановив свого сина Соломона царем над Ізраїлем.

decisions.choice: full of days: having lived a long and complete life
decisions.reason: To be "full of days" is to have had all the years of life one could wish for, said of Isaac (Genesis 35:29) and Job (Job 42:17). It is a mark of blessing, not of weakness.

decisions.choice: a short summary of Solomon's accession
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 1 tells at length how Solomon came to the throne while David was "old, advanced in days" (1 Kings 1:1), against the claim of his brother Adonijah. Chronicles gives only the bare fact here, as a heading for David's last arrangements in chapters 23-29, and tells of Solomon being made king again before all the assembly in 29:22.

decisions.choice: had lived a full life / had lived a long, full life
decisions.reason: As in Genesis 35:29, Balanced and Readable say what "full of days" means; Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: "날이 찼을 때"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture "full of days"; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: farto de dias (L); depois de viver uma vida plena (B); tinha vivido uma vida longa e completa (R)
decisions.reason: As Genesis 35:29 has the same phrase in Portuguese (m1): Literal keeps "farto de dias", and Readable takes Genesis' "uma vida longa e completa"; Balanced says plainly what the phrase means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in this chapter's Amharic (verses 13, 25)
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the reader setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: "ሸመገለ፤ ዘመንንም ጠገበ" (old and full of days, L), "ዕድሜ ጠግቦ" (B), "ረጅምና የተሟላ ሕይወት" (R), as Genesis 35:29
decisions.reason: The phrase keeps the Amharic used for Isaac's old age on main.

decisions.choice: "दिनों से तृप्त" (Literal); "भरपूर आयु पा चुका" (Balanced); "लंबा, भरा-पूरा जीवन जिया था" (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Full of days" keeps the Hindi of Genesis 35:29 at each level (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: "насытился днями"
decisions.reason: The Literal keeps the Hebrew image of a life filled to the full (m1); the other levels say it plainly.

source.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף֙ אֶת־כָּל־שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he gathered all [the] princes of Israel and the priests and the Levites.

en.L: And he gathered all the princes of Israel and the priests and the Levites.
en.B: He gathered together all the officials of Israel, and the priests and the Levites.
en.R: He called together all the leaders of Israel, and the priests and the Levites.

es.L: Y reunió a todos los príncipes de Israel y a los sacerdotes y a los levitas.
es.B: Reunió a todos los jefes de Israel, y a los sacerdotes y a los levitas.
es.R: Convocó a todos los líderes de Israel, y a los sacerdotes y a los levitas.

fr.L: Et il rassembla tous les princes d’Israël, et les prêtres, et les Lévites.
fr.B: Il réunit tous les dignitaires d’Israël, ainsi que les prêtres et les Lévites.
fr.R: Il a réuni tous les chefs d’Israël, ainsi que les prêtres et les Lévites.

sw.L: Akawakusanya wakuu wote wa Israeli na makuhani na Walawi.
sw.B: Aliwakusanya pamoja maafisa wote wa Israeli, na makuhani na Walawi.
sw.R: Aliwaita pamoja viongozi wote wa Israeli, na makuhani na Walawi.

vi.L: Ông tập họp tất cả các thủ lĩnh Y-sơ-ra-ên, các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi.
vi.B: Ông tập họp tất cả các quan chức Y-sơ-ra-ên, cùng các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi.
vi.R: Ông triệu tập tất cả các nhà lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên, cùng các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 이스라엘의 모든 고관과 제사장들과 레위인들을 모았다.
ko.B: 그는 이스라엘의 모든 관리와 제사장들과 레위인들을 모았다.
ko.R: 그는 이스라엘의 모든 지도자와 제사장들과 레위인들을 불러 모았다.

pt.L: E ele reuniu todos os príncipes de Israel, e os sacerdotes e os levitas.
pt.B: Ele reuniu todas as autoridades de Israel, os sacerdotes e os levitas.
pt.R: Ele reuniu todos os líderes de Israel, os sacerdotes e os levitas.

am.L: የእስራኤልንም አለቆች ሁሉ ካህናቱንና ሌዋውያኑን ሰበሰበ።
am.B: የእስራኤልን ሹማምንት ሁሉ፣ ካህናቱንና ሌዋውያኑን በአንድነት ሰበሰበ።
am.R: የእስራኤልን መሪዎች ሁሉ፣ ካህናቱንና ሌዋውያኑን ጠራ።

hi.L: और उसने इस्राएल के सब प्रधानों को, और याजकों को, और लेवियों को इकट्ठा किया।
hi.B: उसने इस्राएल के सब अधिकारियों को, और याजकों और लेवियों को इकट्ठा किया।
hi.R: उसने इस्राएल के सब अगुवों को, और याजकों और लेवियों को बुलाकर इकट्ठा किया।

ru.L: И собрал он всех князей Израиля, и священников, и левитов.
ru.B: Он собрал всех знатных людей Израиля, а также священников и левитов.
ru.R: Он созвал всех вождей Израиля, а также священников и левитов.

uk.L: І зібрав він усіх князів Ізраїля, і священників, і левитів.
uk.B: Він зібрав усіх урядовців Ізраїля, а також священників і левитів.
uk.R: Він скликав усіх провідників Ізраїля, а також священників і левитів.

decisions.choice: the gathering at which the arrangements of chapters 23-27 are made
decisions.reason: This assembly is the setting for the lists of Levites, priests, singers, gatekeepers and officials that follow. David speaks to the gathered leaders again in 28:1.

decisions.choice: princes: the leading men of the tribes and the royal court
decisions.reason: The word names men of rank and authority: tribal leaders, heads of clans and royal officials (27:22; 28:1).

decisions.choice: princes / officials / leaders
decisions.reason: The usual wording for this word in these books: "princes" at Literal, "officials" at Balanced, "leaders" at Readable.

decisions.choice: príncipes (L); jefes (B); líderes (R)
decisions.reason: The *sarim* of Israel, as the English has "princes", "officials", "leaders"; Spanish "jefes" at Balanced, since "oficiales" is kept for the king's servants.

decisions.choice: "les princes" (L); "les dignitaires" (B); "les chefs" (R)
decisions.reason: The word for men of rank follows the English per level (princes, officials, leaders); Balanced uses "dignitaires" because "officiers" would suggest the army.

decisions.choice: wakuu (L); maafisa (B); viongozi (R)
decisions.reason: The *sarim* of Israel are "wakuu" at Literal, "maafisa" at Balanced and "viongozi" at Readable, matching the English princes, officials, leaders, through these chapters.

decisions.choice: "thủ lĩnh" (L), "quan chức" (B), "nhà lãnh đạo" (R)
decisions.reason: One word per level for the *sarim* of Israel, as for the English, kept through chapters 22-29.

decisions.choice: "고관" (L); "관리" (B); "지도자" (R)
decisions.reason: One wording per level for *sarim* through chapters 22-29, as at 22:17.

decisions.choice: os príncipes (L); as autoridades (B); os líderes (R)
decisions.reason: For chapters 23-26: the men of rank (m2) are "príncipes" at Literal, as 27:22 has it in Portuguese, and "líderes" at Readable. Balanced says "autoridades" where the English says "officials", because "oficiais" is kept for the other Hebrew word, the officers who keep records, "oficiais e juízes" (verse 4; 26:29).

decisions.choice: princes (sarim): "प्रधान" (Literal), "अधिकारी" (Balanced), "अगुवे" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Samuel 10:3 and 1 Chronicles 22:17 in this translation for this title, varied by level as the English varies it.

decisions.choice: "князья" (Literal); "знатные люди" (Balanced); "вожди" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The words for the princes (sarim) used in 1 Chronicles 22:17 and 2 Samuel 10:3, kept through the lists of chapters 23-27.

source.text: וַיִּסָּֽפְרוּ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִבֶּ֛ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה וַיְהִ֨י מִסְפָּרָ֤ם לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָם֙ לִגְבָרִ֔ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁמוֹנָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃

records.literal_gloss: And were counted the Levites from [a] son of thirty year[s] and upward, and was their number by their skulls, of men, thirty and eight thousand.

en.L: And the Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward, and their number by their heads, man by man, was 38,000.
en.B: The Levites who were thirty years old and over were counted, and the total, counted man by man, was 38,000.
en.R: The Levites who were thirty years old or older were counted. There were 38,000 men.

es.L: Y fueron contados los levitas de treinta años arriba, y su número, por cabezas, varón por varón, fue de 38 000.
es.B: Se contó a los levitas de treinta años en adelante, y el total, contados uno por uno, fue de 38 000 hombres.
es.R: Se contó a los levitas que tenían treinta años o más. Eran 38 000 hombres.

fr.L: Et les Lévites furent dénombrés depuis l’âge de trente ans et au-dessus, et leur nombre, par tête, homme par homme, fut de 38 000.
fr.B: On fit le dénombrement des Lévites âgés de trente ans et plus, et leur nombre, compté homme par homme, fut de 38 000.
fr.R: On a compté les Lévites qui avaient trente ans ou plus. Il y avait 38 000 hommes.

sw.L: Walawi wakahesabiwa tangu mwana wa miaka thelathini na zaidi, na hesabu yao kwa vichwa vyao, mtu kwa mtu, ilikuwa 38,000.
sw.B: Walawi wenye umri wa miaka thelathini na zaidi walihesabiwa, na jumla yao, wakihesabiwa mtu mmoja mmoja, ilikuwa 38,000.
sw.R: Walawi wenye umri wa miaka thelathini au zaidi walihesabiwa. Walikuwa wanaume 38,000.

vi.L: Người Lê-vi từ ba mươi tuổi trở lên được kiểm tra, và số của họ tính theo đầu người, đàn ông, là 38.000.
vi.B: Những người Lê-vi từ ba mươi tuổi trở lên được kiểm tra, và tổng số, tính từng người nam một, là 38.000.
vi.R: Những người Lê-vi từ ba mươi tuổi trở lên được kiểm tra. Có 38.000 người nam.

ko.L: 그리고 레위인들 가운데 30세 이상 된 자들을 세었는데, 사람마다 머릿수로 센 그들의 수는 38,000명이었다.
ko.B: 30세 이상 된 레위인들을 세었더니, 한 사람 한 사람 센 그 수가 38,000명이었다.
ko.R: 30세 이상 된 레위인들을 세어 보니 38,000명이었다.

pt.L: E os levitas foram contados de trinta anos para cima, e o número deles, por cabeça, homem por homem, foi trinta e oito mil.
pt.B: Os levitas de trinta anos para cima foram contados, e o total, contado homem por homem, foi de trinta e oito mil.
pt.R: Os levitas de trinta anos para cima foram contados. Eram trinta e oito mil homens.

am.L: ሌዋውያኑም ከሠላሳ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት ተቆጠሩ፤ ቁጥራቸውም በየራሳቸው ሰው በሰው 38,000 ነበረ።
am.B: ዕድሜያቸው ሠላሳ ዓመትና ከዚያ በላይ የሆኑ ሌዋውያን ተቆጠሩ፤ አንድ በአንድ የተቆጠሩት ወንዶች ጠቅላላ ቁጥር 38,000 ነበረ።
am.R: ዕድሜያቸው ሠላሳ ዓመትና ከዚያ በላይ የሆኑ ሌዋውያን ተቆጠሩ። 38,000 ወንዶች ነበሩ።

hi.L: और लेवी तीस वर्ष के और उससे ऊपर के गिने गए, और उनकी गिनती, सिर-सिर करके, पुरुष-पुरुष करके, 38,000 थी।
hi.B: तीस वर्ष और उससे अधिक आयु के लेवियों की गिनती हुई, और एक-एक पुरुष को गिनकर उनकी कुल गिनती 38,000 थी।
hi.R: तीस वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के लेवियों को गिना गया। वे 38,000 पुरुष थे।

ru.L: И были исчислены левиты от тридцати лет и выше, и было их число по их головам, мужчин, тридцать восемь тысяч.
ru.B: Левитов от тридцати лет и старше пересчитали, и всего, если считать каждого мужчину, их было тридцать восемь тысяч.
ru.R: Пересчитали левитов, которым было тридцать лет или больше. Их было тридцать восемь тысяч мужчин.

uk.L: І були перелічені левити від тридцяти років і вище, і було їхнє число за їхніми головами, чоловік за чоловіком, тридцять вісім тисяч.
uk.B: Левитів від тридцяти років і старших було перелічено, і загальне їхнє число, чоловік за чоловіком, становило тридцять вісім тисяч.

decisions.choice: thirty years old and upward: the working age set by the law of Moses
decisions.reason: Numbers 4:3 counts the Levites who carried the tabernacle from thirty years old. Verses 24 and 27 of this chapter give twenty as the age; see the note at verse 24.

decisions.choice: by their skulls, of men: a head count of the men
decisions.reason: "By their skulls" means counting one person at a time, as in the census of Numbers 1:2. Only men were counted for this service.

decisions.choice: thousand: read as the number
decisions.reason: On the word "thousand" and the size of such totals, see the note at the census in Numbers 1:21: the word can also name a clan or military unit.

decisions.choice: counted man by man / There were 38,000 men
decisions.reason: Balanced folds "by their skulls" into "counted man by man"; Readable gives just the number of men.

decisions.choice: ages and large numbers in figures ("30세", "38,000명")
decisions.reason: As the Korean Kings drafts write ages, years and large numbers, so the many numbers of chapters 23-27 can be compared at a glance.

decisions.choice: de trinta anos para cima (every level); trinta e oito mil
decisions.reason: The working age of Numbers 4:3 (m1) keeps the words Numbers has in Portuguese, "de trinta anos para cima", at every level, and verses 24 and 27 say "de vinte anos para cima" the same way, so the reader sees the two ages side by side. The total is a round number and is written in words, as this book writes "trinta e seis mil" (7:4).

decisions.choice: "በየራሳቸው ሰው በሰው" (by their heads, man by man) at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew counts by skulls, the usual idiom for a head count; "በየራሳቸው" keeps the picture without the anatomy, as Numbers counts on main.

decisions.choice: numbers in words in the lists of chapters 23-27
decisions.reason: Counts of thousands are written in words, as in 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles 18-19 in this translation; figures are kept for the large census totals of chapter 21.

decisions.choice: David's own words, though no speech is announced
decisions.reason: The Hebrew moves straight from the count to the plan, with no "David said". The "I made" of verse 5 shows that verses 4-5 are David's words.

decisions.choice: to oversee: to direct and lead the work
decisions.reason: The verb means to supervise or lead, used of the overseers of the temple's building and repair (Ezra 3:8-9; 2 Chronicles 34:12). The same root appears in the heading "for the director" of many psalms.

decisions.choice: officials and judges: men who kept records, carried out orders and settled cases
decisions.reason: These are the two offices of Deuteronomy 16:18. Their work was away from the house of God, among the people (26:29 names Levites for this "outside work").

decisions.choice: the house of the LORD: the temple still to be built
decisions.reason: David is preparing for the temple Solomon will build (22:1-19). The plan looks ahead to its work.

decisions.choice: David said,
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who is speaking, since the Hebrew's switch to David's own words in verse 5 would otherwise come as a surprise. Literal opens the quotation without supplied words.

decisions.choice: the LORD's temple
decisions.reason: Readable says "temple" for "the house of the LORD" throughout, since the building, not a home, is meant.

decisions.choice: officials
decisions.reason: The same word is "officials" at Deuteronomy 16:18 and Joshua 1:10, and at 26:29 and 27:1 in this book.

decisions.choice: la casa del SEÑOR (L, B); el templo del SEÑOR (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for the house of the LORD.

decisions.choice: "quan chức và thẩm phán"
decisions.reason: "Thẩm phán" as in the Vietnamese Samuel and 17:6, left for a reviewer against "quan xét".

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집" (L, B); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's words for the house of the LORD, held through chapters 23-29.

decisions.choice: oficiais e juízes (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 26:29): the two offices of Deuteronomy 16:18 (m3) keep the words Deuteronomy has in Portuguese, "oficiais" for the officers who kept records and carried out orders and "juízes", in the Hebrew order of this verse.

decisions.choice: officers (*shoterim*) are "ሹማምንት" and judges "ዳኞች"
decisions.reason: These judges settle cases; "መሳፍንት" is kept for the leaders of the book of Judges, as the terms list sets. David's speech opens with «, as the English opens a quotation, and closes in verse 5.

decisions.choice: "अधिकारी और न्यायी" (officials and judges)
decisions.reason: The pair of Deuteronomy 16:18 in this translation (meaning m3). Literal opens David's words without a speech verb, as the Hebrew and the English Literal do (m1).

decisions.choice: "начальники" for the officials (shoterim)
decisions.reason: These are men who kept records and carried out orders (m3); "начальники" is the general word used for them through these lists.

decisions.choice: divisions: groups that took turns on duty
decisions.reason: The word means a portion or share. In chapters 23-27 it names the groups of Levites, priests, singers, gatekeepers and soldiers who served in turn (24:1; 26:1; 27:1).

decisions.choice: Gershon, Kohath and Merari: the three sons of Levi
decisions.reason: The same three are named in Exodus 6:16, Numbers 3:17 and 1 Chronicles 5:27. In 6:1-2 the first is spelled Gershom; here, as in Exodus and Numbers, he is Gershon.

decisions.choice: the families of Levi's three sons
decisions.reason: Readable says that the divisions follow the families descended from Levi's sons.

decisions.choice: turnos (L, B); grupos que servían por turnos (R)
decisions.reason: The divisions that took turns on duty are "turnos", the word the Spanish New Testament uses for the division of Abijah in Luke 1:5; Readable says what they were.

decisions.choice: "classes"
decisions.reason: The groups that serve in turn are "classes" at Literal and Balanced through chapters 23-27, the usual French word for the priestly and Levitical rotas; Readable says "groupes".

decisions.choice: zamu (L, B); vikundi (R)
decisions.reason: The Levites' "divisions" are "zamu", the word for a group serving by turns; Readable says "vikundi" (groups). The genealogy formula of chapters 23-26 is "Wana wa X: A na B" at Literal and Balanced and "Wana wa X walikuwa A na B" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "ban" (L, B); "nhóm" (R)
decisions.reason: The groups that took turns on duty are "ban" through chapters 23-27, the ordinary word for a shift or division of workers.

decisions.choice: "반열" (L, B); "무리" (R)
decisions.reason: The traditional Korean word for the divisions of priests and Levites (Luke 1:5, 8), held through chapters 23-28; Readable says "무리".

decisions.choice: as turmas (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (24:1; 26:1, 12, 19; 27:1): the groups of Levites, priests, singers, gatekeepers and soldiers who served in turn (m1) are "turmas", the everyday Portuguese word for a group that takes its turn of duty, plain enough for Readable where the English says "groups". "Divisão" would suggest an army unit or a department; Luke 1:5 in Portuguese calls Zechariah's group "a divisão de Abias", and that is the same institution (24:10). "Turno" is kept for the turn of duty itself (25:8; 26:12).

decisions.choice: Gérson
decisions.reason: Levi's son keeps the Portuguese form of Exodus 6:16 and 1 Chronicles 6:1 for both spellings of his name (m2).

decisions.choice: divisions (*maḥleqot*) are "ክፍሎች" at every level, as Luke 1:5's "ከአብያ ክፍል"
decisions.reason: The terms list's word; one word through chapters 23-24 keeps the system of turns clear. Gershon, Kohath and Merari keep main's "ጌድሶን", "ቀዓት" and "ሜራሪ" (Exodus 6:16; Numbers 3:17).

decisions.choice: divisions (machleqot): "दल"; the list formula "X के पुत्र: A और B" (Literal), "X के पुत्र: A, B और C" (Balanced), "X के बेटे A, B और C थे" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Chapters 23-27 keep one list formula per level, the one used in the genealogies of chapters 1-9 in this translation, with the count at the end ("तीन", "कुल तीन", "ये तीन थे") where the Hebrew has it. Divisions are "दल", as 2 Kings 11:7, and the names of Levi's line take the forms of Genesis, Exodus and Numbers.

decisions.choice: "череды" (Literal, Balanced); "группы" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The divisions took turns on duty (m1); "череда" is the word for such a turn of service, and it is kept through chapters 23-27.

decisions.choice: "черга" for the divisions (machloqet)

decisions.choice: the head: the leading member of the family line
decisions.reason: The word "head" marks the man who led his branch of the family, perhaps the eldest. It recurs through the chapter (verses 11, 16-20).

decisions.choice: three: the count closes each family list
decisions.reason: The totals at the end of verses 8-12 and 23 help the reader check each list, as in the census lists of Numbers.

decisions.choice: the head / the chief / the leader
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "head". Balanced says "chief" and Readable "leader"; where "the second" follows, both say "the first" (verses 11, 19, 20).

decisions.choice: "Các con trai của X: A, B và C" (L, B); "Các con trai của X là A, B và C" (R)
decisions.reason: One list formula for the family lists of chapters 23-26, as the terms note asks for the genealogies; "đứng đầu" (L), "trưởng" (B), "người lãnh đạo" (R) for the head of a line.

decisions.choice: "우두머리" (L, B); "지도자" (R); "첫째" where "the second" follows (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English does through the chapter (verses 11, 19, 20).

decisions.choice: o chefe (L, B); o líder (R); o primeiro (B, R) where "o segundo" follows
decisions.reason: For the chapter (verses 11, 16-20) and 24:21: the head of a branch of the family (m1) is "o chefe" at Literal and Balanced, as 15:5 has it, and "o líder" at Readable, as the English moves to "leader"; "o cabeça" would read as slang. Where a numbered list follows, Balanced and Readable say "o primeiro" (verse 11, m2).

decisions.choice: Jeiel, Zetã; Selomote, Haziel, Harã, Jaate, Zina, Ziza, Jeús, Berias, Sebuel, Reabias, Selomite, Jerias, Amarias, Jaaziel, Jecameão, Mica, Issias, Quis, Éder, Jeremote (verses 8-23)
decisions.reason: The names of this chapter's lists take forms already used in Portuguese where there is one ("Jeiel" for Jehiel as at 15:18; "Zetã", "Jeús", "Berias", "Ziza", "Issias", "Jeremote" as in chapters 4, 7 and 12; "Quis", "Mica", "Haziel", "Harã"), and otherwise the usual Brazilian patterns ("-ias" for "-iah", "-ote" for "-oth", "-ão" for "-am" as "Jecameão"). Several are spelled differently in 24:20-31 and 26:21-26 (Shebuel and Shubael, Jeriah and Jerijah); Portuguese keeps each verse's spelling where the forms differ in Portuguese too. The rarer forms await a reviewer.

decisions.choice: the head of a family line is "አለቃው" (L, B), "መሪው" (R); Jehiel "ይሒኤል" and Joel "ኢዮኤል" as on main (Ezra 10:2; 1 Samuel 8:2)
decisions.reason: One word for "the head" through these lists, matching the English levels.

decisions.choice: the head (rosh): "मुखिया" (Literal), "प्रधान" (Balanced), "अगुवा" (Readable); "पहला" (Balanced, Readable) where "the second" follows
decisions.reason: As in the English: the head of a family line is named by level, and where an order of rank follows (verses 11, 19, 20) Balanced and Readable say "पहला", Literal keeps "मुखिया".

decisions.choice: "глава" (Literal, Balanced); "главный" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The leading member of the family line (m1).

source.text: בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְעִ֗י שְׁלוֹמִ֧ית וַחֲזִיאֵ֛ל וְהָרָ֖ן שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה אֵ֛לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י הָאָב֖וֹת לְלַעְדָּֽן׃ס

records.literal_gloss: [The] sons of Shimei: Shelomoth and Haziel and Haran, three. These [were the] heads of the fathers of Ladan.

en.L: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth and Haziel and Haran, three. These [were] the heads of the fathers' [houses] of Ladan.
en.B: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel and Haran, three in all. These were the heads of the families of Ladan.
en.R: Shimei's sons were Shelomoth, Haziel and Haran. That was three. These were the leaders of Ladan's family groups.

es.L: Los hijos de Simei: Selomot y Haziel y Harán, tres. Estos [eran] los jefes de las [casas] paternas de Ladán.
es.B: Los hijos de Simei: Selomot, Haziel y Harán, tres en total. Estos eran los jefes de las familias de Ladán.
es.R: Los hijos de Simei eran Selomot, Haziel y Harán. Eran tres. Estos eran los jefes de los grupos familiares de Ladán.

fr.L: Les fils de Shiméï : Shelomoth, et Haziel, et Harân, trois. Ce [sont] les chefs des [maisons des] pères de Ladân.
fr.B: Les fils de Shiméï : Shelomoth, Haziel et Harân, trois en tout. C’étaient les chefs des familles de Ladân.
fr.R: Les fils de Shiméï étaient Shelomoth, Haziel et Harân. Cela faisait trois. C’étaient les chefs des groupes familiaux de Ladân.

sw.L: Wana wa Shimei: Shelomothi na Hazieli na Harani, watatu. Hawa [ndio] wakuu wa [nyumba za] baba za Ladani.
sw.B: Wana wa Shimei: Shelomothi, Hazieli na Harani, watatu kwa jumla. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wakuu wa jamaa za Ladani.
sw.R: Wana wa Shimei walikuwa Shelomothi, Hazieli na Harani. Hao walikuwa watatu. Hawa ndio waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa za Ladani.

vi.L: Các con trai của Si-mê-i: Sê-lô-mốt, Ha-xi-ên và Ha-ran, ba [người]. Đây [là] những người đứng đầu các gia tộc của La-ê-đan.
vi.B: Các con trai của Si-mê-i: Sê-lô-mốt, Ha-xi-ên và Ha-ran, tất cả là ba người. Đây là những trưởng tộc của La-ê-đan.
vi.R: Các con trai của Si-mê-i là Sê-lô-mốt, Ha-xi-ên và Ha-ran. Tất cả là ba người. Đây là những người lãnh đạo các gia tộc của La-ê-đan.

ko.L: 시므이의 아들들은 슬로못과 하시엘과 하란, 셋[이다]. 이들은 라단의 조상들의 [집안의] 우두머리들[이었다].
ko.B: 시므이의 아들들은 슬로못, 하시엘, 하란, 모두 셋이다. 이들은 라단 가문의 우두머리들이었다.
ko.R: 시므이의 아들들은 슬로못과 하시엘과 하란이었다. 모두 세 사람이었다. 이들은 라단 집안의 지도자들이었다.

pt.L: Os filhos de Simei: Selomote e Haziel e Harã, três. Estes [eram] os chefes das [casas] dos pais de Ladã.
pt.B: Os filhos de Simei: Selomote, Haziel e Harã, três ao todo. Esses eram os chefes das famílias de Ladã.
pt.R: Os filhos de Simei foram Selomote, Haziel e Harã. Eram três. Esses eram os líderes dos grupos de famílias de Ladã.

am.L: የሰሜኢ ልጆች፦ ሰሎሞት፣ ሐዚኤልና ሐራን፣ ሦስት። እነዚህ የለዓዳን የአባቶች [ቤቶች] አለቆች ነበሩ።
am.B: የሰሜኢ ልጆች፦ ሰሎሞት፣ ሐዚኤልና ሐራን፤ በአጠቃላይ ሦስት። እነዚህ የለዓዳን የቤተሰብ አለቆች ነበሩ።
am.R: የሰሜኢ ልጆች ሰሎሞት፣ ሐዚኤልና ሐራን ነበሩ። ሦስት ነበሩ። እነዚህ የለዓዳን የቤተሰብ መሪዎች ነበሩ።

hi.L: शिमी के पुत्र: शलोमोत और हजीएल और हारन, तीन। ये लादान के पितरों के [घरानों] के प्रधान [थे]।
hi.B: शिमी के पुत्र: शलोमोत, हजीएल और हारन, कुल तीन। ये लादान के परिवारों के प्रधान थे।
hi.R: शिमी के बेटे शलोमोत, हजीएल और हारन थे। ये तीन थे। ये लादान के परिवारों के मुखिया थे।

ru.L: Сыновья Семея: Шеломоф, и Хазиил, и Харан — трое. Это главы отцовских [домов] Ладана.
ru.B: Сыновья Семея: Шеломоф, Хазиил и Харан — всего трое. Это были главы семей Ладана.
ru.R: У Семея были сыновья Шеломоф, Хазиил и Харан. Их было трое. Это были главы семей Ладана.

uk.L: Сини Шімеї: Шеломот, і Хазіїл, і Гаран, троє. Це [були] голови батьківських [домів] Ладана.
uk.B: Сини Шімеї: Шеломот, Хазіїл і Гаран, усього троє. Це були голови родин Ладана.
uk.R: Синами Шімеї були Шеломот, Хазіїл і Гаран. Усього троє. Це були провідники Ладанових родів.

decisions.choice: Shelomoth, as the reading in the margin has it
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text has Shelomith, and the reading handed down in the margin has Shelomoth. The margin's form is kept here. A Levite of verse 18 is also called Shelomith, and appears as Shelomoth in 24:22.

decisions.choice: Shimei here: probably a son of Ladan, not the brother of verse 7
alternatives: the same Shimei as in verses 7 and 10
decisions.reason: These three are called heads of Ladan's families, so this Shimei seems to be a son of Ladan, otherwise unnamed. The Shimei of verse 7, Ladan's brother, has his own sons in verse 10. The text may also have suffered in copying, with another of Ladan's sons first written here.

decisions.choice: heads of the fathers' [houses] / heads of the families
decisions.reason: As in 9:33-34, Literal shows the Hebrew "heads of the fathers" with brackets, and Balanced and Readable speak of families.

decisions.choice: jefes de las [casas] paternas (L); jefes de las familias (B); jefes de los grupos familiares (R)
decisions.reason: The "heads of the fathers' houses" of these lists, one wording per level through chapters 23-29.

decisions.choice: os chefes das [casas] dos pais
decisions.reason: As 15:12 in Portuguese, Literal shows the Hebrew "heads of the fathers" with a bracket for the houses, as the English does (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: heads of fathers' houses are "የአባቶች [ቤቶች] አለቆች" (L), "የቤተሰብ አለቆች" (B), "የቤተሰብ መሪዎች" (R), as Joshua 21:1 and Numbers 31:26
decisions.reason: Main's wording for the phrase; Haran is "ሐራን", the man's name as in Genesis 11, not the city "ካራን".

decisions.choice: "पितरों के [घरानों] के प्रधान" (Literal); "परिवारों के प्रधान" (Balanced); "परिवारों के मुखिया" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The heads of the fathers' houses keep the wording of 1 Chronicles 9:33-34 and 15:12 in this translation at each level, through chapters 23-27.

decisions.choice: "главы отцовских [домов]" (Literal); "главы семей" (Balanced); "главы семей" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The father's house in the forms of the Pentateuch note ("отцовский дом" at Literal, "семья" at Balanced and Readable), as 5:13; "род" stays for the clan.

source.text: וּבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְעִ֔י יַ֣חַת זִינָ֔א וִיע֖וּשׁ וּבְרִיעָ֑ה אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵי־שִׁמְעִ֖י אַרְבָּעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, and Jeush and Beriah. These [were the] sons of Shimei, four.

en.L: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, and Jeush and Beriah. These [were] the sons of Shimei, four.
en.B: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush and Beriah. These were the sons of Shimei, four in all.
en.R: Shimei's sons were Jahath, Zina, Jeush and Beriah. These four were Shimei's sons.

es.L: Y los hijos de Simei: Jahat, Zina, y Jeús y Bería. Estos [eran] los hijos de Simei, cuatro.
es.B: Los hijos de Simei: Jahat, Zina, Jeús y Bería. Estos eran los hijos de Simei, cuatro en total.
es.R: Los hijos de Simei eran Jahat, Zina, Jeús y Bería. Estos cuatro eran hijos de Simei.

fr.L: Et les fils de Shiméï : Yahath, Zina, et Yeoush, et Beria. Ce [sont] les fils de Shiméï, quatre.
fr.B: Les fils de Shiméï : Yahath, Zina, Yeoush et Beria. C’étaient les fils de Shiméï, quatre en tout.
fr.R: Les fils de Shiméï étaient Yahath, Zina, Yeoush et Beria. Ces quatre-là étaient les fils de Shiméï.

sw.L: Na wana wa Shimei: Yahathi, Zina, na Yeushi na Beria. Hawa [ndio] wana wa Shimei, wanne.
sw.B: Wana wa Shimei: Yahathi, Zina, Yeushi na Beria. Hawa ndio wana wa Shimei, wanne kwa jumla.
sw.R: Wana wa Shimei walikuwa Yahathi, Zina, Yeushi na Beria. Hao wanne ndio waliokuwa wana wa Shimei.

vi.L: Các con trai của Si-mê-i: Gia-hát, Xi-na, Giê-úc và Bê-ri-a. Đây [là] các con trai của Si-mê-i, bốn [người].
vi.B: Các con trai của Si-mê-i: Gia-hát, Xi-na, Giê-úc và Bê-ri-a. Đây là các con trai của Si-mê-i, tất cả là bốn người.
vi.R: Các con trai của Si-mê-i là Gia-hát, Xi-na, Giê-úc và Bê-ri-a. Bốn người này là con trai của Si-mê-i.

ko.L: 그리고 시므이의 아들들은 야핫, 시나와 여우스와 브리아[이다]. 이들이 시므이의 아들들, 넷[이다].
ko.B: 시므이의 아들들은 야핫, 시나, 여우스, 브리아이다. 이들은 시므이의 아들들로, 모두 넷이다.
ko.R: 시므이의 아들들은 야핫과 시나와 여우스와 브리아였다. 이 네 사람이 시므이의 아들들이었다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Simei: Jaate, Zina, e Jeús e Berias. Estes [eram] os filhos de Simei, quatro.
pt.B: Os filhos de Simei: Jaate, Zina, Jeús e Berias. Esses foram os filhos de Simei, quatro ao todo.
pt.R: Os filhos de Simei foram Jaate, Zina, Jeús e Berias. Esses quatro eram os filhos de Simei.

am.L: የሰሜኢም ልጆች፦ ያሐት፣ ዚና፣ ይዑስና በሪዓ። እነዚህ የሰሜኢ ልጆች ናቸው፤ አራት።
am.B: የሰሜኢ ልጆች፦ ያሐት፣ ዚና፣ ይዑስና በሪዓ። እነዚህ የሰሜኢ ልጆች ነበሩ፤ በአጠቃላይ አራት።
am.R: የሰሜኢ ልጆች ያሐት፣ ዚና፣ ይዑስና በሪዓ ነበሩ። እነዚህ አራቱ የሰሜኢ ልጆች ነበሩ።

hi.L: और शिमी के पुत्र: यहत, जीना, और यूश और बरीआ। ये शिमी के पुत्र [थे], चार।
hi.B: शिमी के पुत्र: यहत, जीना, यूश और बरीआ। ये शिमी के पुत्र थे, कुल चार।
hi.R: शिमी के बेटे यहत, जीना, यूश और बरीआ थे। ये चारों शिमी के बेटे थे।

ru.L: И сыновья Семея: Иахаф, Зина, и Иеус, и Берия. Это сыновья Семея — четверо.
ru.B: Сыновья Семея: Иахаф, Зина, Иеус и Берия. Это были сыновья Семея — всего четверо.
ru.R: У Семея были сыновья Иахаф, Зина, Иеус и Берия. Эти четверо были сыновьями Семея.

uk.L: І сини Шімеї: Яхат, Зіна, і Єуш, і Берія. Це [були] сини Шімеї, четверо.
uk.B: Сини Шімеї: Яхат, Зіна, Єуш і Берія. Це були сини Шімеї, усього четверо.
uk.R: Синами Шімеї були Яхат, Зіна, Єуш і Берія. Ці четверо були синами Шімеї.

decisions.choice: Zina: the same man as Zizah in verse 11
decisions.reason: The next verse calls him Zizah, and some ancient translations read Zizah here too. The two forms differ by one letter that is easily confused in Hebrew writing. The text is kept as it stands.

decisions.choice: Jeush "ይዑስ" and Beriah "በሪዓ", the forms of the same Hebrew names in Genesis 36:5 and 46:17
decisions.reason: Names keep their forms on main; Jahath "ያሐት" and Zina "ዚና" are new.

source.text: וַֽיְהִי־יַ֣חַת הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְזִיזָ֖ה הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וִיע֤וּשׁ וּבְרִיעָה֙ לֹֽא־הִרְבּ֣וּ בָנִ֔ים וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ לְבֵ֣ית אָ֔ב לִפְקֻדָּ֖ה אֶחָֽת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And was Jahath the head, and Zizah the second; and Jeush and Beriah did not make many sons, and they became for a house of a father, for one enrollment.

en.L: And Jahath was the head, and Zizah the second; and Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, and they became one father's house, for one enrollment.
en.B: Jahath was the first and Zizah the second. Jeush and Beriah had few sons, so they were counted as a single family with one assignment.
en.R: Jahath was the first, and Zizah was second. Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons. So their families were counted together as one family group with one duty.

es.L: Y Jahat era el jefe, y Ziza el segundo; pero Jeús y Bería no tuvieron muchos hijos, y llegaron a ser una sola casa paterna, para un solo registro.
es.B: Jahat era el primero y Ziza el segundo. Jeús y Bería tuvieron pocos hijos, así que fueron contados como una sola familia con un solo cargo.
es.R: Jahat era el primero, y Ziza el segundo. Jeús y Bería no tuvieron muchos hijos. Por eso sus familias se contaron juntas como un solo grupo familiar con una sola tarea.

fr.L: Et Yahath était le chef, et Ziza le second ; et Yeoush et Beria n’eurent pas beaucoup de fils, et ils devinrent une seule maison de père, pour un seul recensement.
fr.B: Yahath était le premier, et Ziza le second. Yeoush et Beria eurent peu de fils, si bien qu’ils furent comptés comme une seule famille, avec une seule charge.
fr.R: Yahath était le premier, et Ziza le deuxième. Yeoush et Beria n’avaient pas beaucoup de fils. Leurs familles ont donc été comptées ensemble, comme un seul groupe familial avec un seul service.

sw.L: Yahathi alikuwa mkuu, na Ziza wa pili; lakini Yeushi na Beria hawakuzaa wana wengi, kwa hiyo wakawa nyumba moja ya baba, kwa hesabu moja.
sw.B: Yahathi alikuwa wa kwanza na Ziza wa pili. Yeushi na Beria walikuwa na wana wachache, kwa hiyo walihesabiwa kama jamaa moja yenye zamu moja.
sw.R: Yahathi alikuwa wa kwanza, na Ziza alikuwa wa pili. Yeushi na Beria hawakuwa na wana wengi. Kwa hiyo jamaa zao zilihesabiwa pamoja kama jamaa moja yenye kazi moja.

vi.L: Gia-hát đứng đầu, Xi-xa thứ hai; còn Giê-úc và Bê-ri-a không có nhiều con trai, nên họ thành một gia tộc, một lần kiểm tra.
vi.B: Gia-hát là trưởng, Xi-xa thứ hai. Giê-úc và Bê-ri-a có ít con trai, nên họ được tính chung là một gia tộc với một phần nhiệm vụ.
vi.R: Gia-hát đứng đầu, Xi-xa thứ hai. Giê-úc và Bê-ri-a không có nhiều con trai, nên gia đình hai ông được tính chung thành một gia tộc với một nhiệm vụ.

ko.L: 그리고 야핫이 우두머리였고, 시사가 둘째였다. 그리고 여우스와 브리아는 아들을 많이 두지 못하여, 한 조상의 집이 되어 한 번의 등록으로 [세어졌다].
ko.B: 야핫이 첫째였고 시사가 둘째였다. 여우스와 브리아는 아들이 많지 않아서, 한 가문으로 세어져 한 가지 임무를 맡았다.
ko.R: 야핫이 첫째였고 시사가 둘째였다. 여우스와 브리아는 아들이 많지 않았다. 그래서 그들의 집안은 한 가문으로 함께 세어져 한 가지 일을 맡았다.

pt.L: E Jaate era o chefe, e Ziza, o segundo; e Jeús e Berias não tiveram muitos filhos, e se tornaram uma só casa paterna, para uma só contagem.
pt.B: Jaate era o primeiro, e Ziza, o segundo. Jeús e Berias tiveram poucos filhos, por isso foram contados como uma só família, com uma só tarefa.
pt.R: Jaate era o primeiro, e Ziza era o segundo. Jeús e Berias não tiveram muitos filhos. Por isso as famílias deles foram contadas juntas, como um só grupo de família com uma só tarefa.

am.L: ያሐትም አለቃ ነበረ፤ ዚዛም ሁለተኛ፤ ይዑስና በሪዓ ግን ብዙ ልጆች አልወለዱም፤ ስለዚህ አንድ የአባት ቤት፣ አንድ ምዝገባ ሆኑ።
am.B: ያሐት የመጀመሪያው፣ ዚዛ ሁለተኛው ነበረ። ይዑስና በሪዓ ግን ጥቂት ልጆች ስለ ነበሯቸው አንድ ተግባር ያለው አንድ ቤተሰብ ሆነው ተቆጠሩ።
am.R: ያሐት የመጀመሪያው፣ ዚዛም ሁለተኛው ነበረ። ይዑስና በሪዓ ብዙ ልጆች አልነበሯቸውም። ስለዚህ ቤተሰቦቻቸው በአንድነት አንድ ተግባር ያለው አንድ ቤተሰብ ሆነው ተቆጠሩ።

hi.L: और यहत मुखिया था, और जीजा दूसरा; और यूश और बरीआ के बहुत पुत्र न हुए, इसलिए वे एक ही पितृकुल, एक ही गिनती के लिए, ठहरे।
hi.B: यहत पहला था और जीजा दूसरा। यूश और बरीआ के पुत्र थोड़े थे, इसलिए उन्हें एक ही परिवार गिना गया, जिसका एक ही काम था।
hi.R: यहत पहला था और जीजा दूसरा। यूश और बरीआ के बहुत बेटे नहीं थे। इसलिए उनके परिवारों को मिलाकर एक ही परिवार गिना गया, जिसका एक ही काम था।

ru.L: И был Иахаф главой, а Зиза вторым; а у Иеуса и Берии было немного сыновей, и они стали одним отцовским домом, одним счётом.
ru.B: Иахаф был первым, а Зиза вторым. У Иеуса и Берии было мало сыновей, поэтому их считали одной семьёй с одной обязанностью.
ru.R: Иахаф был первым, а Зиза вторым. У Иеуса и Берии было немного сыновей. Поэтому их семьи считали вместе, как один род с одной обязанностью.

uk.L: І був Яхат головою, а Зіза другим; а Єуш і Берія не мали багато синів, і стали вони одним батьківським домом, для одного перепису.
uk.B: Яхат був першим, а Зіза другим. Єуш і Берія мали мало синів, тож їх перелічили як одну родину з одним обовʼязком.
uk.R: Яхат був першим, а Зіза другим. Єуш і Берія не мали багато синів. Тож їхні родини перелічили разом як один рід з одним обовʼязком.

decisions.choice: one enrollment: a single unit for duty
decisions.reason: The word means a counting, or the post a counted group was given. Two small families were counted together as one father's house, so that they took one turn of service together.

decisions.choice: the head ... the second: an order of rank
decisions.reason: "The head" here stands first in a numbered list, and so means the first. Verses 19 and 20 follow the same pattern.

decisions.choice: the first
decisions.reason: Where "the second" follows, Balanced and Readable say "the first" for "the head", as verse 8's decision says.

decisions.choice: uma só casa paterna, para uma só contagem (L)
decisions.reason: "Casa paterna" is the Portuguese phrase for a father's house; "contagem" keeps the sense of a counting that gives a group its post (m1), which Balanced and Readable call "tarefa".

decisions.choice: "одним счётом" (Literal); "с одной обязанностью" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: One enrollment is a single unit for duty (m1).

source.text: בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֗ת עַמְרָ֥ם יִצְהָ֛ר חֶבְר֥וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵ֖ל אַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: [The] sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel, four.

en.L: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel, four.
en.B: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel, four in all.
en.R: Kohath's sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel. That was four.

es.L: Los hijos de Coat: Amram, Izhar, Hebrón y Uziel, cuatro.
es.B: Los hijos de Coat: Amram, Izhar, Hebrón y Uziel, cuatro en total.
es.R: Los hijos de Coat eran Amram, Izhar, Hebrón y Uziel. Eran cuatro.

fr.L: Les fils de Kehath : Amram, Jitsehar, Hébron et Ouzziel, quatre.
fr.B: Les fils de Kehath : Amram, Jitsehar, Hébron et Ouzziel, quatre en tout.
fr.R: Les fils de Kehath étaient Amram, Jitsehar, Hébron et Ouzziel. Cela faisait quatre.

sw.L: Wana wa Kohathi: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli, wanne.
sw.B: Wana wa Kohathi: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli, wanne kwa jumla.
sw.R: Wana wa Kohathi walikuwa Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli. Hao walikuwa wanne.

vi.L: Các con trai của Kê-hát: Am-ram, Gít-sê-ha, Hếp-rôn và U-xi-ên, bốn [người].
vi.B: Các con trai của Kê-hát: Am-ram, Gít-sê-ha, Hếp-rôn và U-xi-ên, tất cả là bốn người.
vi.R: Các con trai của Kê-hát là Am-ram, Gít-sê-ha, Hếp-rôn và U-xi-ên. Tất cả là bốn người.

ko.L: 그핫의 아들들은 아므람, 이스할, 헤브론과 웃시엘, 넷[이다].
ko.B: 그핫의 아들들은 아므람, 이스할, 헤브론, 웃시엘, 모두 넷이다.
ko.R: 그핫의 아들들은 아므람과 이스할과 헤브론과 웃시엘이었다. 모두 네 사람이었다.

pt.L: Os filhos de Coate: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom e Uziel, quatro.
pt.B: Os filhos de Coate: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom e Uziel, quatro ao todo.
pt.R: Os filhos de Coate foram Anrão, Izar, Hebrom e Uziel. Eram quatro.

am.L: የቀዓት ልጆች፦ እንበረም፣ ይስዓር፣ ኬብሮንና ዑዝኤል፣ አራት።
am.B: የቀዓት ልጆች፦ እንበረም፣ ይስዓር፣ ኬብሮንና ዑዝኤል፤ በአጠቃላይ አራት።
am.R: የቀዓት ልጆች እንበረም፣ ይስዓር፣ ኬብሮንና ዑዝኤል ነበሩ። አራት ነበሩ።

hi.B: कहात के पुत्र: अम्राम, यिसहार, हेब्रोन और उज़्ज़ीएल, कुल चार।
hi.R: कहात के बेटे अम्राम, यिसहार, हेब्रोन और उज़्ज़ीएल थे। ये चार थे।

ru.L: Сыновья Каафа: Амрам, Ицгар, Хеврон и Узиил — четверо.
ru.B: Сыновья Каафа: Амрам, Ицгар, Хеврон и Узиил — всего четверо.
ru.R: У Каафа были сыновья Амрам, Ицгар, Хеврон и Узиил. Их было четверо.

uk.L: Сини Кегата: Амрам, Їцгар, Хеврон і Уззіїл, четверо.
uk.B: Сини Кегата: Амрам, Їцгар, Хеврон і Уззіїл, усього четверо.
uk.R: Синами Кегата були Амрам, Їцгар, Хеврон і Уззіїл. Усього четверо.

decisions.choice: the four sons of Kohath
decisions.reason: The same four are named in Exodus 6:18, Numbers 3:19 and 1 Chronicles 5:28.

decisions.choice: "Jitsehar"
decisions.reason: The French Exodus (6:18) writes Kehath’s son "Jitsehar"; the published form is kept.

decisions.choice: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel keep main's "እንበረም", "ይስዓር", "ኬብሮን" and "ዑዝኤል" (Exodus 6:18; Numbers 3:19)
decisions.reason: Levite names keep their forms in Exodus and Numbers.

source.text: בְּנֵ֥י עַמְרָ֖ם אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּמֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּבָּדֵ֣ל אַהֲרֹ֡ן לְֽהַקְדִּישׁוֹ֩ קֹ֨דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֤ים הֽוּא־וּבָנָיו֙ עַד־עוֹלָ֔ם לְהַקְטִיר֩ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֧ה לְשָׁרְת֛וֹ וּלְבָרֵ֥ךְ בִּשְׁמ֖וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. And was set apart Aaron to consecrate it, holy of holies, he and his sons until forever, to make smoke before Yahweh, to serve him and to bless in his name until forever.

en.L: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. And Aaron was set apart to consecrate the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn [offerings] before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to minister to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and to bless in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name forever.
en.B: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron was set apart, he and his sons for all time, to consecrate the most holy things, to burn offerings before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to minister to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and to bless in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name forever.
en.R: Amram's sons were Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were chosen and set apart forever to make the most holy things holy. They were to burn offerings to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. And they were to bless the people in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name for all time.

es.L: Los hijos de Amram: Aarón y Moisés. Y Aarón fue apartado para consagrar las cosas santísimas, él y sus hijos para siempre, para quemar [ofrendas] delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para servirle y para bendecir en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre para siempre.
es.B: Los hijos de Amram: Aarón y Moisés. Aarón fue apartado, él y sus hijos para siempre, para consagrar las cosas santísimas, para quemar ofrendas delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para servirle y para bendecir en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre para siempre.
es.R: Los hijos de Amram eran Aarón y Moisés. Aarón y sus descendientes fueron escogidos y apartados para siempre para santificar las cosas santísimas. Debían quemar ofrendas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y servirle. Y debían bendecir al pueblo en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre por todos los tiempos.

fr.L: Les fils d’Amram : Aaron et Moïse. Et Aaron fut mis à part pour consacrer les choses très saintes, lui et ses fils, pour toujours, pour faire fumer [les offrandes] devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir et pour bénir en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom pour toujours.
fr.B: Les fils d’Amram : Aaron et Moïse. Aaron fut mis à part, lui et ses fils pour toujours, pour consacrer les choses très saintes, pour brûler les offrandes devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir et pour bénir en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom à jamais.
fr.R: Les fils d’Amram étaient Aaron et Moïse. Aaron et ses descendants ont été choisis et mis à part pour toujours afin de consacrer les choses très saintes. Ils devaient brûler les offrandes devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir. Et ils devaient bénir le peuple en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom pour toujours.

sw.L: Wana wa Amramu: Haruni na Musa. Haruni akatengwa ili kuvitakasa vitu vitakatifu kabisa, yeye na wanawe milele, kufukiza [sadaka] mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kumhudumia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, na kubariki kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} milele.
sw.B: Wana wa Amramu: Haruni na Musa. Haruni alitengwa, yeye na wanawe kwa vizazi vyote, ili kuvitakasa vitu vitakatifu kabisa, kufukiza sadaka mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kumhudumia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, na kubariki kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} milele.
sw.R: Wana wa Amramu walikuwa Haruni na Musa. Haruni na wazao wake walichaguliwa na kutengwa milele ili kuvifanya vitu vitakatifu kabisa kuwa vitakatifu. Walipaswa kufukiza sadaka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumtumikia. Tena walipaswa kuwabariki watu kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} siku zote.

vi.L: Các con trai của Am-ram: A-rôn và Môi-se. A-rôn được biệt riêng để thánh hóa các vật chí thánh, ông và các con trai ông đến đời đời, để đốt [lễ vật] trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, để phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và để nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà chúc phước đến đời đời.
vi.B: Các con trai của Am-ram: A-rôn và Môi-se. A-rôn được biệt riêng, ông và các con trai ông mãi mãi, để thánh hóa các vật chí thánh, để đốt lễ vật trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, để phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và để nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà chúc phước đời đời.
vi.R: Các con trai của Am-ram là A-rôn và Môi-se. A-rôn và con cháu ông được chọn và biệt riêng mãi mãi để làm cho các vật chí thánh nên thánh. Họ phải đốt lễ vật dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Họ cũng phải nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà chúc phước cho dân chúng mãi mãi.

ko.L: 아므람의 아들들은 아론과 모세[이다]. 그리고 아론은 구별되어, 그와 그의 아들들이 영원히 지극히 거룩한 것을 거룩하게 하고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 분향하고, 그분을 섬기고, 그분의 이름으로 영원히 축복하게 되었다.
ko.B: 아므람의 아들들은 아론과 모세이다. 아론은 구별되어, 그와 그의 아들들이 영원히 지극히 거룩한 것들을 거룩하게 하고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 분향하며, 그분을 섬기고, 그분의 이름으로 영원히 축복하는 일을 맡았다.
ko.R: 아므람의 아들들은 아론과 모세였다. 아론과 그의 자손들은 영원히 구별되어 지극히 거룩한 것들을 거룩하게 하는 일을 맡았다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제물을 태워 드리고 그분을 섬겨야 했다. 또 그분의 이름으로 언제까지나 백성에게 복을 빌어 주어야 했다.

pt.L: Os filhos de Anrão: Arão e Moisés. E Arão foi separado para consagrar as coisas santíssimas, ele e os seus filhos para sempre, para queimar [ofertas] diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, para servi-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} e para abençoar em {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome para sempre.
pt.B: Os filhos de Anrão: Arão e Moisés. Arão foi separado, ele e os seus filhos para todo o sempre, para consagrar as coisas santíssimas, para queimar ofertas diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, para servi-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} e para abençoar em {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome para sempre.
pt.R: Os filhos de Anrão foram Arão e Moisés. Arão e os seus descendentes foram escolhidos e separados para sempre para tornar santas as coisas santíssimas. Eles deviam queimar ofertas {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e servi-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}. E deviam abençoar o povo em {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome para sempre.

am.L: የእንበረም ልጆች፦ አሮንና ሙሴ። አሮንም እጅግ ቅዱስ የሆኑትን ነገሮች ይቀድስ ዘንድ፣ እርሱና ልጆቹ ለዘላለም፣ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት [መሥዋዕት] ያቃጥሉ ዘንድ፣ ያገለግሉትም ዘንድ፣ በስሙም ለዘላለም ይባርኩ ዘንድ ተለየ።
am.B: የእንበረም ልጆች፦ አሮንና ሙሴ። አሮንና ልጆቹ እጅግ ቅዱስ የሆኑትን ነገሮች እንዲቀድሱ፣ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት መሥዋዕት እንዲያቃጥሉ፣ እርሱን እንዲያገለግሉና በስሙ ለዘላለም እንዲባርኩ ለዘላለም ተለዩ።

decisions.choice: to consecrate the most holy things
alternatives: to be consecrated as most holy
decisions.reason: The verb has an ending "it" or "him". Read as "it", Aaron was set apart to consecrate the most holy things, the holiest offerings and objects of the sanctuary (Exodus 30:29; Numbers 18:9-10). Read as "him", the sense is that Aaron was set apart to be consecrated as most holy. The first reading fits the list of tasks that follows.

decisions.choice: to burn offerings: to make offerings go up in smoke on the altar
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something smoke. It is used both of burning incense (Exodus 30:7) and of burning the parts of a sacrifice on the altar (Leviticus 1:9). Both were the work of the priests alone (2 Chronicles 26:18).

decisions.choice: to bless in his name: the priestly blessing
decisions.reason: The words echo Deuteronomy 10:8 and 21:5, and the blessing that Aaron and his sons were to speak over Israel in the LORD's name (Numbers 6:23-27).

decisions.choice: set apart, he and his sons forever: the priesthood belongs to Aaron's line
decisions.reason: The verse marks the line between the priests and the other Levites: Moses' sons are counted among the Levites (verse 14), while Aaron's line alone serves as priests (Numbers 18:1-7).

decisions.choice: bless the people
decisions.reason: Readable says who is blessed, as in Deuteronomy 10:8, and uses "descendants" for "sons" since the line runs on for all time.

decisions.choice: consagrar as coisas santíssimas
decisions.reason: The reading of m1: "as coisas santíssimas" are the holiest offerings and objects, as Numbers 18:9 says in Portuguese, kept apart from "o Lugar Santíssimo", the inner room. "Abençoar em seu nome" keeps the words of Deuteronomy 10:8 in Portuguese (m3).

decisions.choice: the most holy things are "እጅግ ቅዱስ የሆኑት ነገሮች"
decisions.reason: The settled rule: "እጅግ ቅዱስ" for most holy things and offerings, "ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን" only for the Most Holy Place.

decisions.choice: "[መሥዋዕት] ያቃጥሉ" (burn offerings), not "ያጥኑ" (burn incense)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one for making any offering go up in smoke, as the meaning decision says; "ማጠን" would narrow it to incense.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span ("उनकी सेवा", "उनके नाम से")
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans (style guide, section 7); respect for God is carried by the honorific third person. This holds wherever the English has such a span in this chapter. The blessing in his name keeps the wording of Deuteronomy 10:8.

decisions.choice: "Святое святых" (Literal); "самое святое" (Balanced); "самые святые вещи" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The phrase here means the most holy things the priests handle (m1), not the inner room; Literal keeps the phrase of the Pentateuch note, the other levels say what it refers to.

decisions.choice: the daughters married their cousins
decisions.reason: When a man died without sons, his daughters received his inheritance, and they were to marry within their father's clan so that it stayed in the family (Numbers 27:1-11; 36:6-12). Kish was Eleazar's brother, so his sons were the daughters' cousins.

decisions.choice: took them: married them
decisions.reason: "To take" a woman is the usual way of saying "to marry" (Genesis 24:67).

decisions.choice: their brothers / their relatives / their cousins
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "brothers" covers any close kinsman. Literal keeps "brothers"; Balanced says "relatives" and Readable "cousins", which is what the family line shows.

decisions.choice: "형제" (L); "친족" (B); "사촌들" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "brothers" covers any close kinsman; Readable says "cousins", as the English Readable does, which the family line shows.

decisions.choice: nenhum filho homem (R)
decisions.reason: Portuguese "filhos" can include daughters; Literal and Balanced set it against "somente filhas", which makes the sense plain, and Readable says "filho homem" so that a young reader does not stumble.

decisions.choice: "उनके भाई" (Literal); "उनके संबंधी" (Balanced); "चचेरे भाई" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in the English: the Hebrew "brothers" covers close kinsmen; Readable names the kinship the family line shows (meaning m1), for which Hindi has the exact word "चचेरे भाई" (sons of a father's brother).

decisions.choice: "их братья" (Literal); "родственники" (Balanced); "двоюродные братья" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "brothers" here are cousins (m1); the Literal keeps the word and "взяли" (took) for married (m2).
